Pull student work into every local clone

Source: R/github.R
pull_repos.Rd

Fetches each enrolled student's repo and rebases the local clone onto it, so the clones hold whatever students have pushed since you last looked.

pull_repos(roster, dir = here::here(), repo_col = "gh", dry_run = FALSE)

Arguments

roster

Course roster data frame with netID, enrolled, and repo_col.

dir

Directory containing the local clones. Defaults to here::here(); pass the folder that holds them (e.g. here::here("repos")).

repo_col

Roster column holding each repo's exact name, also used as the local clone folder name under dir. Defaults to "gh".

dry_run

If TRUE, report which repos are behind without rebasing.

Value

Invisibly, a tibble with one row per enrolled student and a status column (pulled, uptodate, skipped, conflict, failed, or would_pull).

Details

Run this before push_repos(), every time. push_repos() only stages, commits, and pushes – it never fetches – so the moment a student commits their own work the clone is behind and the push is rejected with "Updates were rejected because the remote contains work that you do not have locally".

Rebase (not merge) keeps the history linear: local commits not yet pushed (feedback PDFs, refreshed starter files) replay on top of the student's work. Uncommitted changes are stashed and restored around the rebase (--autostash). Instructor and student rarely touch the same file, so conflicts are unusual; a repo that does conflict is left mid-rebase and reported as conflict for you to resolve by hand.

Purely local git plus a fetch from each clone's own origin, so no org argument is needed. Repos that aren't cloned yet are skipped – see clone_repos().
